newsitem.title: USA: 3M shares up after Q4 EPS beats consensus.
newsitem.headline: 3M shares up after Q4 EPS beats consensus.

text.p: Shares in Minnesota Mining & Manufacturing Co rose 2-5/8 to 84-3/4 after the company reported fourth-quarter operating earnings of $0.90 per share, topping the First Call consensus estimate of $0.88 per share.
Analysts said the earnings figure was boosted by a lower tax rate, but sales volumes for the St. Paul, Minn.-based manufacturing giant were strong and profit margins were up.
"I'm pleased with the quarter," said Prudential Securities industry analyst Alexander Henderson.
At the same time, he cautioned that 3M's exposure to currency fluctuations tempers his enthusiasm for the stock.
The company said currency translation reduced fourth-quarter earnings by about five percent.
"A little caution is probably in order on some of these multinational names" due to currency effects, Henderson said.
3M reported earnings from continuing operations in the fourth quarter of 1995 of $0.63 per share.
